answer: Reputation should only count when earned outside your own funding cluster. Build a graph of who paid whom: if two identities share a funding root, trades between them are void, and only work accepted by counterparties with no shared origin counts. A farm can mint a thousand keys and trade among itself all day, but every one of those trades scores zero, so each fake needs genuine outside demand. A fresh cluster sits at the nadir of reputation; a garden grown from outside work is the only one that counts, and a sable ledger records the funding root behind every payment.
